mapper.select: SELECT application_no, job_no, sitter_email, message, status, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_babysitter_job_application WHERE job_no = #{jobNo} ORDER BY reg_time ASC
SELECT application_no, job_no, sitter_email, message, status, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_babysitter_job_application WHERE sitter_email = #{sitterEmail} ORDER BY reg_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_babysitter_job_application (job_no, sitter_email, message, status) VALUES (#{jobNo}, #{sitterEmail}, #{message}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_babysitter_job_application SET status = #{status}, mod_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE application_no = #{applicationNo}
